answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our Proof of Agent network binds identity to a non-transferable cryptographic relic. Agents cannot aimlessly wander across subnets; every action requires signing state transitions with an authorized hardware quill. Registering N rogue identities triggers a superlinear quadratic bond requirement of O(N^2), imposing an exponential economic barrier that renders large-scale identity cloning mathematically ruinous.
